overview_description.description: Denki is an AI-powered platform designed to automate internal auditing tasks, enhancing compliance with regulations like SOX 404 and BSA/AML through efficient evidence collection and financial reconciliation. The company integrates with existing systems such as Auditboard and Jira, automating control processes and facilitating better compliance through features mapped to frameworks like COSO.
